note.question: What determines the competitive implications of security risks and customization capability on consumer purchase choices and vendors’ pricing and investment strategies?
note.overview: Because of its on-demand feature and flexible pay-as-you-go mechanism, cloud service dramatically reduces the up-front information technology expenses that may deter many clients from implementing on-premises software. The associated security risks and low customization capability, however, create challenges for the adoption of cloud service. This paper studies the competitive implications of security risks and customization capability on consumer purchase choices and vendors’ pricing and investment strategies.
